frontendArchitecture.title: Frontend Architecture
frontendArchitecture.description: We design and implement frontend systems that scale with your organization. From component libraries to state management patterns, we build foundations that last.
frontendArchitecture.problem: Many companies struggle with fragmented frontend codebases, inconsistent patterns, and architecture that doesn't scale with team growth.

approach.a1: Comprehensive architecture audits and system design
approach.a2: Component library development with design system integration
approach.a3: State management patterns optimized for your use case

microfrontends.title: Micro-frontends & Module Federation
microfrontends.description: Break monolithic frontends into independently deployable applications. Enable teams to ship faster without coordination overhead.
microfrontends.problem: Large frontend applications become bottlenecks when multiple teams need to deploy features independently. Coordination costs slow everyone down.

platformEngineering.title: Platform Engineering
platformEngineering.description: Build internal platforms that accelerate development. From monorepo setup to CI optimization, we create infrastructure that multiplies team productivity.
platformEngineering.problem: Engineering teams lose hours to slow builds, manual processes, and tooling that doesn't scale. Developer experience directly impacts velocity.

approach.a1: Monorepo architecture with Nx or Turborepo

aiIntegration.title: AI Product Integration
aiIntegration.description: Integrate AI capabilities into your products with production-ready architecture. From RAG systems to streaming interfaces, we build AI experiences that feel native.
aiIntegration.problem: Teams struggle to move AI prototypes to production. Integration challenges, latency issues, and UX patterns are common blockers.

approach.a2: Streaming UI patterns for AI responses

modernization.title: Product Modernization
modernization.tagline: Legacy migrations and technical debt reduction
modernization.description: Transform legacy applications into modern, maintainable systems. We plan and execute migrations that minimize risk while maximizing value.
modernization.problem: Legacy codebases accumulate technical debt that slows development and increases maintenance costs. Complete rewrites are risky and expensive.
